faq.q: What does a before and after video maker create?
faq.a: It makes a short ad where one thing changes and the product stays. A coffee ring can disappear from a coaster while the camera remains in place.

faq.q: How do I get from a photo to that clip?
faq.a: Upload the before photo and describe the after in a sentence. Read the line when the file comes back, then change captions or music before export.

faq.q: Which shop is this built for?
faq.a: It is for catalogs with many small changes to show, rather than one film for a month. Google Ads can take a wide file, TikTok a tall one, and Meta a square.

faq.q: What does a before and after clip cost?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. Pro is $35 for 300 credits, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the number before it starts. If the video fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: Can the file run as an ad I paid for?
faq.a: Yes. Commercial use is part of a paid plan, and the download has no watermark. You still need rights to the photo you uploaded.

faq.q: Which frames can I leave with?
faq.a: You can download 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Use the wide file for Google Ads, the tall one for TikTok, or the square for Meta.

faq.q: Can every product in the catalog get a clip?
faq.a: Yes. Send a photo for each cleaner or product page, and you get a separate clip for each. Store software can request them through the API.

faq.q: Should we stop filming changes ourselves?
faq.a: No. Use this tool when you need many tests of a wipe or tidy-up, and keep a filmed piece for a flagship spot that needs your own camera.

faq.q: Could TikTok or Meta turn the ad down?
faq.a: Read their current rules before you spend. Some categories want a label when a viewer might think a real buyer is reviewing the product. The person on screen is a generated presenter.

definition.title: What Is a Before and After Video Maker?
paras: The product stays in frame. What changes is an object or the space around it: a coffee ring on a coaster, then the ring gone. Skin and bodies are not the subject.
A wide file can sit where Google Ads asks for one. A tall file can go to TikTok, and a square can go to Meta. You approve the line before any file leaves.

reasons.h2: Why Use a Before and After Video Maker
reasons.lead: The shopper should see what the product does.

items.t: Show the Dry Half and the Cream
items.d: A cream ad should show the same hand, dry on one side and moisturized on the other, with the jar in frame. The line has to name that cream.
items.alt: The same adult hand: dry flaky skin on the left half, a soft moisturized look on the right half, with a plain white cream jar.

items.t: Export the Right Ad Format
items.d: A Google Ads buy can take the wide file. TikTok can take the tall one. A Meta square is a third choice. You are not recutting a mystery size somewhere else.
items.alt: The same camel knit sweater: pills on the left half, a smooth surface on the right half, with a plain sage electric fabric shaver.

items.t: Test Different Voice Tones
items.d: Two versions give the brand a choice of tone for the same mess.
items.alt: The same wood cutting board: whole garlic cloves and skins on the left half, pressed garlic and a plain stainless garlic press on the right half.
